policy.allowlist: every id must also appear in corpus/n64_sources.json; that file stays the single list of admissible repositories
policy.recipe_authority: flags transcribed from the pinned Makefile; the Makefile sha256 is checked before every run so drift refuses instead of silently compiling with stale flags
policy.verification: upstream-matched C compiled with the repository's recorded recipe; NOT verified against a ROM locally
policy.use: training data only; never evaluation, never prompt context for held-out functions

per_file_flags.why: Makefile:293 `$(BUILD_DIR)/$(SRC_DIR)/get_stack_pointer.c.o: OPT_FLAGS += -dollar`. The file returns `(StackInfo *) __$sp`, and without -dollar cfe reports `Unknown character $ ignored` and then fails the source. This is the ONLY per-file C override in game code; the other two are the assembly file src/hasm/ido/math_util.s (-O2, -mips3 -32), which no C recipe compiles.

rom.note: Read from the repository's own verification file at the pinned commit. No US v77 ROM is held locally, so it is unverified against a dump.

us.v77.extraction_note: Not declared: no US v77 dump is held, so this variant yields only the files that compile without asset_enums.h.

rom.note: Matches roms/Diddy Kong Racing (Europe) (En,Fr,De) (Rev 1).z64 in this workspace.

extraction.why: include/enums.h includes asset_enums.h, which the repository generates from the ROM. Without it 39 of 47 source files fail to compile. The Makefile cannot be used: it downloads binutils from GNU.org while make is still PARSING, so even `make -n` reaches the network. These three commands are what `make extract` and `make build_assets` do, and they run under tools/sandbox_extract.py with the network denied.

repositories.notes: Game code under src/ has exactly one per-file C override (see per_file_flags); the earlier note claiming there were none was wrong and cost one file. Rule: $(CC) -c $(CFLAGS) $(CC_WARNINGS) $(OPT_FLAGS) $(MIPSISET). GLOBAL_ASM is an empty macro in include/macros.h; files using it are skipped because their assembly comes from ROM extraction. The only difference between the two variants is -DVERSION_$(REGION)_$(VERSION): Makefile:153 builds it from REGION and VERSION, Makefile:152 lists the rest, Makefile:190 pins BOOT_CIC to 6103 for both regions on a matching build, and OPT_FLAGS/MIPSISET (Makefile:148-150) are region-independent. Version-gated functions are excluded anyway by conditional_free, so the two variants differ in which functions are eligible, not in how an eligible one compiles.
